cover: Maintenance handover: settle these before launch

slides.title: Who receives the alerts?
slides.body: Uptime and error monitoring only helps if a named person reads it and knows what to do next.

slides.title: Who approves urgent work?
slides.body: A known vulnerability in a package holding patient data can't wait for the next monthly cycle.

slides.title: What does the budget cover?
slides.body: Agree which bug fixes and small changes count as maintenance and which need their own estimate.

slides.title: What depends on outside services?
slides.body: Each payment provider, calendar service or API can change underneath you. List them while the builders still remember.

slides.title: When was a backup last restored?
slides.body: Restoring one is the only way to know it works. Ask how long recovery takes.

slides.title: How are updates tested?
slides.body: Automated tests and a staging site cut the manual checking on each update. Ask which checks are still done by hand.
